metadata.description:
It’s a chair. But it’s also… not just a chair. The oversized bronze seat outside Northrop Auditorium invites visitors to sit, spin, and snap a quirky photo—or just ponder why it exists at all. This Minneapolis Marvel POAP celebrates your appreciation for functional sculpture and whimsical detours in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Minneapolis Marvel 
GPS: 44.97571, -93.23537 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97571,-93.23537
